figures.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Create a sophisticated full-color biology textbook illustration on a clean warm-white background, approximately square. This is a WORDLESS illustration base for a Chinese university textbook figure; all type, labels, numbers, legends and arrows will be added separately in PowerPoint. Absolutely NO TEXT, letters, numbers, watermark or arrows anywhere.
Teaching subject: RNA roles in a eukaryotic cell. The upper 70 percent of the canvas is ONE large elegant cell cutaway, viewed slightly obliquely, with a translucent pale teal membrane and cytoplasm. Clearly show a large cut-open nucleus on the LEFT, with a thin nuclear envelope and visible pores. Inside the nucleus, at upper left, a short accurate double-stranded DNA helix, below it a single precursor RNA with several dark-teal exon segments separated by thinner warm-amber intron segments. Below that, show splicing as a small plausible spliceosome RNP complex bound to an RNA loop (molecular shapes, no arrows), and a joined mature mRNA strand leading through a nuclear pore toward the RIGHT cytoplasm. In the RIGHT half, one enlarged recognizable two-subunit ribosome embracing single-stranded mRNA, a recognizable L-shaped tRNA with an amino acid on its upper tip, and a short emerging amino-acid chain. Ribosome rendered as rounded molecular volumes with a visible rRNA ribbon, not a geometric dome icon. Separate the DNA, precursor RNA, splicing complex, exported mature mRNA and translation complex with ample negative space so clean editable labels and arrows can be added. Keep these elements large and legible, not densely realistic. Do not add mitochondria or unrelated organelles. Position important molecular objects inward from the cell outline so there is space for short labels in the nucleus and cytoplasm.
Below the cell, in the bottom 22 percent, show THREE separate elegant molecular vignettes, unframed, horizontally spaced with ample white space: left, a short small-RNA guide paired to a longer single-stranded target RNA within a subtle protein complex (miRNA/siRNA concept); center, one long folded noncoding RNA with several natural hairpin loops; right, a clearly CLOSED circular RNA loop with continuous backbone. No DNA helices in these bottom vignettes. Leave the very bottom 7 percent blank for later labels.
Visual art direction: beautiful editorial science illustration with softly shaded natural biological forms, subtle watercolor/gouache texture and crisp edges, anatomically suggestive but clearly schematic. Restrained jewel teal, sea green, muted blue and small amber accents, charcoal-free delicate contours, white breathing room. Do not make it a corporate flowchart, a grid of cards, clipart, flat SVG icons, toy plastic, shiny photorealistic 3D, or a dark background. Do not imitate a specific living artist. The aim is visually rich yet calm, sophisticated and immediately understandable. Make it high resolution.

Use case: scientific-educational.
Create an exceptionally polished full-color biology textbook illustration, WORDLESS and on a pure white background, wide horizontal composition about 3:1. Three biological subjects, clearly separated by generous white space, aligned at a similar visual scale with full silhouettes visible. LEFT: one recognizable mammalian neuron, with a softly shaded star-shaped soma, visible round nucleus, numerous beautifully branching dendrites and one longer axon ending in a small branched terminal. CENTER: one elongated fusiform muscle cell, with a visible nucleus and fine organized parallel contractile fibers, gracefully horizontal/diagonal, not an entire arm or muscle organ. RIGHT: a small contiguous row of three columnar epithelial cells, naturally rounded cuboidal/columnar volumes with translucent pale teal membranes, visible round nuclei and restrained apical microvilli, no tissue backdrop.
These are reference cell TYPE illustrations for a figure about different transcriptomes in the same organism. Make the nuclei coherent in style. Do not imply different DNA sequences. Do not draw any charts, bars, icons, boxes, labels, numbers, letters, arrows, logo, watermark, matrix or headings. Do not draw RNA abundance schematics; they will be added precisely as editable graphical data below this illustration. Keep an ample blank margin around every subject, including dendrites and axon tips. No object may be cropped.
Visual style must be a sophisticated colorful university biology textbook plate: soft natural biological volumes, fine watercolor/gouache shading, subtle molecular texture, crisp readable contours, restrained teal and sea-green membranes with muted blue-violet nuclei and small amber details. Editorial scientific illustration rather than flat SVG icons or glossy toy plastic. The neuron, muscle cell and epithelial cells must be clearly different in silhouette. Clean flat white background, no shadows that join unrelated subjects, no decorative frames. High resolution.
figures.editPrompt: Edit this wordless biology textbook illustration only to improve the framing. Preserve the three cell types, their biological structures, watercolor/gouache style, color palette and left-to-right order. Zoom out slightly and complete the neuron's branches on the far left so that every dendrite tip, axon tip, muscle cell tip and epithelial cell edge is fully inside the canvas. Keep at least 4% clean white padding on all four outer edges. Preserve the wide 3:1 aspect ratio. No labels, text, numbers, arrows, panels or charts. Do not add any extra cells or subjects.

composition: Generated biological illustrations are bitmap assets. Chinese labels, arrows and bar charts are separately authored native PowerPoint objects. Labels, counts and directions were checked before final export.
